build_Transformer: build a Transformer model with configurable encoder and decoder layers for mask2former segmentation
create_TransformerEncoder: create a TransformerEncoder with cloned encoder layers and optional layer normalization
create_TransformerDecoder: create a TransformerDecoder with cloned decoder layers and intermediate output support
review_TransformerEncoderLayer: review the TransformerEncoderLayer self-attention and feedforward operations with pre/post normalization options
review_TransformerDecoderLayer: review the TransformerDecoderLayer self-attention cross-attention and feedforward operations with normalization options
